### DangerousBorrow&lt;T&gt;(void*, PgMemoryContext)

Borrows an exclusively accessible palloc-compatible list after validating its native cell tag.

```csharp
public static PgList<T> DangerousBorrow<T>(void* address, PgMemoryContext owner) where T : unmanaged
```

Type parameters:

`T`

The expected cell type.

Parameters:

`address` — [void*](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.void)

The native List pointer; null represents a valid empty list.

`owner` — [PgMemoryContext](/api/ankus.pgmemorycontext/)

The exact allocator context for both the header and any separate cell buffer.

Returns: <code>PgList&lt;T&gt;</code>

A borrowed list whose disposal leaves native storage intact.

Exceptions:

- [ArgumentException](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception): The native list has a different cell tag.

The caller proves valid storage and exclusive access until disposal or detach. An owner
anchor cannot detect external frees. Mutations may free or replace the native container;
obtain its current pointer after structural changes. Pointer elements are never freed.

<a id="member-30192ee04064a791"></a>

### DangerousTryBorrow&lt;T&gt;(void*, PgMemoryContext, out PgList&lt;T&gt;?)

Attempts an exclusive typed borrow, returning false only for a mismatched native tag.

```csharp
public static bool DangerousTryBorrow<T>(void* address, PgMemoryContext owner, out PgList<T>? list) where T : unmanaged
```

Type parameters:

`T`

The expected cell type.

Parameters:

`address` — [void*](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.void)

The native List pointer, including null for NIL.

`owner` — [PgMemoryContext](/api/ankus.pgmemorycontext/)

The exact native allocator context and reset-sensitive lifetime anchor.

`list` — <code>PgList&lt;T&gt;</code>

The borrowed wrapper on success, otherwise null.

Returns: [bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)

Whether the native tag matches; NIL matches every supported cell type.

The same allocator, exclusive-access and lifetime requirements as DangerousBorrow apply.
Unsupported server versions, invalid metadata and dead contexts still throw.
